identity_model.name: line-stable-group-multiset/v1
identity_model.normalized_message: Unicode NFC, trim, collapse internal whitespace runs to a single space
identity_model.multiplicity: group_multiplicity = number of baseline occurrences in the stable group
identity_model.ordering: group_ordinal = 1-based rank by ascending (line,column) at baseline; used for the contiguous slice partition and as a diagnostic, NOT as durable identity
identity_model.interchangeability: occurrences within one stable group are semantically interchangeable (identical path+linter+normalized_message, identical mechanical fix); ownership is enforced by required multiplicity (count) decrease, never by line/column position
identity_model.ownership: every governed occurrence is owned by exactly one remediation task as an exact disjoint occurrence-count partition of its stable group; split groups are owned by an ordered slice chain over contiguous ordinal ranges
identity_model.expected_residual: verifier expected residual for a group after a task = group_multiplicity minus the summed owned_count of that task and every slice ordered at-or-before it; equivalently the summed owned_count of strictly-later slices
identity_model.line_column_role: line and column are diagnostic baseline coordinates only and are never part of the durable ownership identity
